Definition: Ataroth, the name (thus simply) of two places in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Ataroth = "crowns"; 1) a town east of the Jordan in Gilead, taken and built by the tribe of Gad; 2) a place on the boundary of Ephraim and Manasseh; 3) a place between Ephraim and Benjamin
